overview: The Darien Police Department uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Darien CT PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Darien CT PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Darien CT PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, reproductive health care, gender-affirming health services, or any health care services that are legal in the State of Connecticut, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and the audit of searches is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.

more_info.LPR Deployment Overview: Darien CT PD currently operates multiple License Plate Reader (LPR) cameras. Multiple of these are stationary and installed in fixed locations, while one is a mobile (flex) unit that is deployed temporarily for events or specific public safety needs.
